about: GP-ROUND: the ONE ordered remote check list of the Gaming-PC's first round (gpc, gpb, gpd, gpn, gpx notes merged). collect.mjs runs every step whose kind is read, in this order, saves each answer and judges want/refuse. Steps of kind write or ktest run only when asked (--write, --ktest). 'note' is what a human compares by eye; [U] marks what nobody has seen on this machine yet. GP-R2: 'facts' are read from the machine before the first step (never guessed); a step's 'when' changes what it expects per fact ('!' = the fact does not hold); a want/refuse item that is a list means its parts on one line in that order; seen 15.11. = round 1 (generation 107) showed it. GP-R3: 'phases' are round 2 (plan/guides/gaming-pc-runde2.md): collect.mjs --phase <id> runs one of them in order and stops at its first red; a phase step {use: <id>} is that step of the first round's list with its own fields over it; kinds sound (only with --sound, after Georg's yes), install (host/mcp/install.mjs --upload with --bundle), confirm (the running generation confirmed itself), keys (Georg types at the Gaming-PC, the events are read back); 'keep'/'same' keep lines of an answer (the guard hashes) in out/keep and compare a later answer with them.
